title: Fixed-Income Pricing and the Replication of Liabilities
abstract: arXiv:2512.14662v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a model-free framework for static fixed-income pricing and the replication of liability cash flows. The absence of static arbitrage across a universe of fixed-income instruments is equivalent to the existence of a strictly positive discount curve reproducing all observed prices. Linear programming duality then identifies the least-cost super-replication price with the largest value that any admissible discount curve assigns to the liability, so that the resulting bounds are attained and cannot be improved. Complementary slackness confines over-replication to dates that the optimal discount vector prices at zero, and a least-cost portfolio matches the liability exactly at no fewer dates than the rank of the cash-flow matrix. We also obtain generic uniqueness of that portfolio, an interpolation between quadratic hedging and super-replication, and a static treatment of swap--repo strategies. On US Treasury cross-sect

translated_title: 固定收益定价与负债复制
translated_abstract: 本文为静态固定收益定价和负债现金流复制建立了一个无模型框架。在一组固定收益工具上不存在静态套利，等价于存在一条严格为正的贴现曲线能够重现所有观测到的价格。随后，线性规划对偶性将最低成本的超复制价格与任何可行贴现曲线赋予负债的最大价值等同起来，从而使所得的界能够被达到且无法再改进。互补松弛条件将过度复制限制在最优贴现向量定价为零的日期上，而一个最低成本组合在不少于现金流矩阵秩的日期数上精确匹配负债。我们还得到了该组合的一般唯一性、二次对冲与超复制之间的插值，以及对互换-回购策略的静态处理。在美国国债横截面数据上……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无模型的静态固定收益定价与负债复制框架，利用线性规划对偶性证明最低成本超复制价格等于可行贴现曲线赋予负债的最大价值，并进一步给出组合唯一性、二次对冲与超复制之间的插值以及互换-回购策略的静态处理等结果。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a model-free framework for static fixed-income pricing and liability replication, using linear programming duality to show that the least-cost super-replication price equals the maximum value any admissible discount curve assigns to the liability, with additional results on portfolio uniqueness, interpolation between quadratic hedging and super-replication, and static swap-repo strategies.
